remarks: No active tropical cyclones in the JMA basin for the seventh run running. Nothing is approaching any tracked port, so there are no threat rows again this week.

No new closures, strikes or emergency suspensions at any tracked port. Every suspension still circulating in the trade press is a historical Typhoon Saudel or Dolphin event from August and early September.

All three per-port sources are stale rather than clean. SEKO has not moved since 11 September, the Kuehne+Nagel weekly still covers 2-8 September, and MSC has published nothing relevant since 3 September. Read the absence of new closure reports as an absence of evidence, not as confirmed normality.

Shanghai/Ningbo stays on the panel one more run with its 12 September eventEnded untouched, so the site retires it on its own schedule rather than being pushed.
